Do the test are properly isolated on Windows ? (Normally the datasource connection string defines different schemas...).
The quick and dirty solution would be to add `drop table` statements before creating tables.

@danielpetisme yes, the solution is to perform a `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS`. I have created a PR in 
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/4449

What I don't understand is why it fails only on Windows?
There is a deeper problem because the tests should be isolated. Normally each suite has its own schema...
